SCRIPT W-Am Thank you so much for organizing the annual company picnic, Jingdao. Everybody seemed to enjoy it. M-Au Well, we deserved it after working so hard this year. W-Am I agree. The food was great, by the way. Especially the peach pie you made. Would you mind sharing the recipe? It was delicious. M-Au I found the recipe online. I'll send you a link to the Web page. There’s a really helpful video that walks you through all the steps. I recommend you watch it first. W-Am All right, thanks.

SCRIPT M-Cn I'd like to finish calculating the company’s expense reports for the month. Have you finished reviewing the travel reimbursement forms from all the departments? W-Br I'm almost done, but I have a question about a hotel receipt from one of our employees. M-Cn What's the problem? W-Br Well, our policy is for employees to stay at a hotel that's on our list of approved accommodations. This one isn't on the list. M-Cn Who submitted the receipt? W-Br Moritz Ziegler, one of our sales representatives. M-Cn Hmm. He's a new employee and may have forgotten the policy. As a supervisor, I can approve the expense this one time.

SCRIPT M-Au Good morning, Damilola. How's everything up here on deck? W-Br Hi, Pedro. It was an uneventful night, and our cargo ship still hasn’t moved yet. M-Au Hmm, I hope the fog over the harbor lifts soon. W-Br Yeah, me too. The ship won’t be able to leave until the weather improves. M-Au I hope we won't get too far behind schedule. I'll be sure to call the port authority soon for an update on when we'll be cleared to leave. W-Br Sounds good.

SCRIPT W-Br Hi. I’ve made a reservation to meet with some clients for lunch today. It’s under Cohen. M-Au Oh, yes. I see your reservation. Welcome, Ms. Cohen. W-Br I know I asked to be seated on your beautiful terrace, but it’s very hot today. M-Au Hmm. I can seat you at table four inside. Do you mind waiting a few minutes? W-Br Not at all. By the way, your parking area’s nearly full. Where can I tell my clients to park? M-Au Our customers can park for free in the garage across the street. Our cashier will stamp their parking tickets. W-Br Oh, great. Thanks. I'll call them and let them know.

SCRIPT W-Am Thank you both for coming here today to demonstrate your company’s new compact printer. I know the store will be busy because we're having a big sale on laptop computers and tablets. M-Cn We're happy to be here. Our printers are perfect for students or people with home offices who may have limited space. My partner, Murat, will be setting up the printer station. M-Au Yes—where can I put our demonstration table? W-Am I'll show you the area. Also, if you brought any brochures with you, it’ll be helpful to put those out for people to take.

SCRIPT W-Am Gizem and Hector, I’m very pleased with the sales of our brands of cakes, pies, and cookies this past holiday season. Any thoughts on what we should be concentrating on going forward? W-Br The biggest trend right now is the reduction of sugar. The public wants healthier products, but the same great taste. That'll be our biggest challenge. M-Cn One of our ingredient suppliers recently started offering a sweetener made entirely from natural ingredients. W-Am Are there similar ones on the market? And how do they compare? M-Cn I‘d have to do some investigation to find out more about that. I have some time available tomorrow afternoon.

SCRIPT M-Au Hi, Bianca. I'm calling to see if you’d have time to work on a project for my marketing firm. We've expanded a lot in the past year, and we need some help. W-Am Thanks for thinking of me. What type of work would I be doing? M-Au Well, we have a new client in Brazil who’s interested in creating a marketing campaign for social media sites. You'd be overseeing the campaign. W-Am Oh, I have experience with that. Why don’t you send me a detailed description of the work? That'll give me an idea of how much time this project will take.

SCRIPT W-Br Hey, Koji? We were about to pack van number five for the music festival when we noticed it’s got a flat tire. M-Au Oh. That's not good. W-Br We're supposed to get there by eleven to set up lunch for the performers. Is there another van we can take? M-Au Let me see what's available. We’ve got a lot of catering jobs today. Ah, yes—we can use van number three. Do you need help loading? W-Br Yes, thanks. The food’s already in coolers, but everything’s in the kitchen with the serving utensils and napkins. It all needs to be brought to the parking area. M-Au All right; I can help with that.

SCRIPT M-Cn Thanks for taking my call. As I mentioned in my e-mail, I’m interested in working in your field. But I’m talking to some professionals first so I can find out more about it. W-Am Happy to help. M-Cn So how did you get your start? W-Am Oh, my family always subscribed to three newspapers. So I always thought the news was important. At my university, I joined the newspaper and eventually worked my way up to being an editor. M-Cn Wow. Is it true that people in the news business work very long hours? So what's your schedule like?

SCRIPT M-Au Hi, Karen! I just read the article on the company Web site about the proposed merger with QZ Corporation. It looks like we’re going ahead with it. W-Br There would be a lot of advantages to merging operations, although they also talked about it last year. M-Au I remember that. But there were a lot of details to work out—like whether our offices would stay in Chicago. Now it looks like we won't be relocating. W-Br Well, I really don’t want to move, so that’s a relief.

SCRIPT M-Au Thanks for calling Customized Concepts. How can I help you? W-Am My company wants to give every employee a gift, something useful but not too big. Since we’re about to host our annual staff basketball tournament, I thought a water bottle might be good. M-Au We carry a few drink containers. If you’re at our Web site, you'll see them under the Lifestyle tab. W-Am Let me pull it up now... All right. M-Au I recommend the metal bottle with the wide-mouthed lid. It’s easier to clean than the one with the straw. W-Am OK, thanks. And you could put our company logo on it, right? M-Au Yes. You'll just need to send me the graphic file. W-Am I can do that.

SCRIPT W-Br Yun, I just finished recording the audio guide for the pencil drawings that'll be included in our modern art exhibit next week. The files'Il be loaded onto the audio devices tomorrow. M-Cn That's great. But, unfortunately, we have to make one change. The drawing by Claudia Hoffman will no longer be in the exhibit. There was a scheduling mix-up, and it was promised to another museum starting next week. W-Br Oh, that’s too bad. That was one of my favorite pieces. Will you put anything in its place? M-Cn No. We'll just remove it. W-Br OK, then I'll make that change to the audio-guide recording. I'll do that right away.

SCRIPT M-Cn I’m glad we were assigned to cover the press conference earlier today. I counted seven other major media networks there, in addition to ours. W-Am Well, the offshore wind industry is going to transform the way this region gets its power. M-Cn Agreed. Let’s compare our facts before we start writing. W-Am So the largest cluster of wind turbines— off the coast of Winston—is already built. The other sites are at different stages of construction, though Lanchester is also close to being done. M-Cn Right. And I think it’s crucial for us to focus on how many new jobs related to assembling and maintaining the turbines are opening up in the area as a result of this.

SCRIPT M-Au You have reached the information line for the Cranbury Apartments management office. On Monday, April twelfth, maintenance work will begin to repave the entire parking area adjacent to our building’s main entrance. All Cranbury residents should move their vehicles from their designated parking spots before eight a.m. on Monday. Any vehicle still in its spot after eight a.m. will be towed at the owner’s expense. A map of alternate parking sites was mailed to residents last week and is also posted in the building lobby.

SCRIPT W-Am Welcome to Your House Works. On today’s episode, we'll go over how you can maintain and make minor repairs to the roof of your home. The first thing to do is to invest in a few special tools, like a trowel and crowbar. It's important to choose some that are high quality because you'll use them for many years. With your trowel and some roof cement, you can seal any cracks or chips. The crowbar will help you remove loose shingles that you can then replace. Now, I highly recommend you take photos of your roof every year so that you can track its overall condition.

SCRIPT W-Br Thanks again for joining me on today’s tour of the beautiful Wallingford Conservatory. I hope you enjoyed seeing and learning about the many species of plants and flowers we care for here. As I mentioned at the beginning of the tour, world-renowned botanist Samantha Hughes will be giving a lecture on the care of flowering orchid plants at two o’clock in the community Room. I recommend attending. Samantha’s work has also been featured in a documentary film called Orchid Caretakers, which you can purchase through the conservatory’s online gift shop. I watched it recently and learned many new things about the orchid species we have right here at the conservatory.

SCRIPT M-Au Before the benefit concert begins, I want to thank all of you for supporting the Hillcaster Community Center. As you know, our facilities have been in need of some repairs for quite a while. So far, we've raised 5,000 dollars in ticket sales, but we haven’t quite reached our goal yet. So during the concert, I want to encourage you to buy food and drinks from the concession stand. Eighty percent of the proceeds will go to construction at the Hillcaster Community Center. Enjoy the music!

SCRIPT M-Cn Thank you all for attending today’s workshop. Erina Kimura and I will be conducting the session, and we'll be focusing on using time efficiently as a business owner. Planning and spending your time wisely is a key factor to business success. During the presentation, I'll be referring to documents from the packet you were handed as you arrived. If you don’t have one yet, Erina’s at the back of the room. OK then, to start off, we'll do an exercise to get to know one another better.

SCRIPT W-Br At this site, archaeologists have uncovered the remains of a fifth-century marketplace with colorful mosaic tiles on the walls. You'll notice how vibrant the colors are, even after all these centuries. This is what the ruins are most famous for. You can still see intricate details in the artists’ pictures of scenes from daily life. Now, to protect the mosaics, a roof has been constructed over the area, and the lights are dim. And I'm sorry, but taking photos is not allowed, as the flash would damage the tiles. As we proceed, please hold on to the handrails on either side. They'll help you stay on the path and protect the ruins around us.

SCRIPT M-Cn As you all know, our agency’s just won an important contract with Parker Auto Parts Company. We'll be developing two 30-second ads for local radio stations to be released next month and two additional 20-second ads for the following month. Now, I know it’s a tight schedule, but this is a priority. The client has actually started trying to work on this internally, there's a rough ad we can start editing. Let's work on that now.

SCRIPT W-Am Excuse me, nurses. Attention please. I've been receiving complaints about the free snacks in the hospital break rooms. Some people have mentioned that they don’t like the selection of snacks, and some have said that they don’t get to eat them at all because they're gone by the time the evening shift starts. So I was thinking about putting some money into each of your staff spending accounts every month so that you can buy the snacks you want at the hospital cafeteria. That will require management approval, but I'll keep you posted.

SCRIPT M-Cn As mayor of Lakeville, I’m pleased to welcome you to the celebration for our town’s newly renovated Lakeville Park. There are a lot of new areas to explore, so we’ve planned a short hike. We'll be walking around the pond and along the renovated walking trail. We’ll end our walk on the hill on the north side of the park. There we'll be having some free snacks and ice cream. For those of you taking photos, don’t forget to post them on the city’s Web site. We'd like to commemorate this special day.

SCRIPT W-Br Thanks, everyone, for attending today’s free public lecture, sponsored by the Springfield Farmers’ Association. So, we've received lots of requests for information on growing a vegetable garden. People want to know how to keep their garden healthy and get the vegetables they want. The first thing we recommend is regular soil testing. Since this is September, all soil samples in the next six weeks should be taken from the same depth, as seen on this chart. Oh, and before you leave today, please sign up for our mailing list to stay informed of future lectures.

The Bryant Foyer is one of the premier event spaces in our area. Set on a hill, it has expansive windows that provide sweeping views of the adjacent botanical gardens and the river. Built in 1897, it was the home of the Francona Charitable Trust until its renovation just over a year ago. Today, the space can accommodate up to 200 guests and is ideal for wedding receptions, office parties, and panel presentations. With its marble floors, cathedral ceiling, and stunning artwork, the Bryant Foyer is the ideal location for your next gathering.

The on-site restaurant, Andito's, caters our events and also operates as its own business. This farm-to-table restaurant, headed by chef Michaela Rymond, meets all dietary needs and has revolutionized the local food scene. Area residents know to plan far in advance to get a seat.

To reserve the event space or to make a dinner reservation, give us a call at 216-555-0157.

FOR IMMEDIATE RELEASE

SYDNEY (4 June)—Kitchen Swifts and Chef Darius Cordero are joining together to give home cooks a new culinary experience. The award-winning chef is the owner of restaurants in both the Philippines and Australia, including the recently opened Enriqua’s. He says his cooking reflects his Filipino heritage, which is a blend of many cultures.

“I’ve designed these simplified recipes for Kitchen Swifts so that cooks at home can enjoy new and exciting flavours with ease,” he said. “While preparing and eating these meals, you can feel like you are travelling the world with me.”

Zahra Chambers, vice president of Kitchen Swifts, says she is pleased to work with Chef Cordero and to offer delicious new recipes to their customers. Kitchen Swifts supplies menus, recipes, and ingredients for two people, four people, or six people, including a range of vegetarian selections. Customers choose the most appropriate meal options, and then a box is delivered weekly. Current customers will see no price increase with the partnership. To find out more, visit the Kitchen Swifts Web site at www.kitchenswifts.com.au.

https://www.sydneyrestaurants.com.au

A colleague arranged for us to eat at Enriqua's while I was at a conference in Sydney. It is usually fully booked for dinner; you may need to call months in advance for a table. We had a wonderful lunch there instead. Everything was delicious, and the bread and desserts are baked on-site! It was a worthwhile treat before I flew back to Hong Kong.

—Meili Guan

Caribbean Flavours Abound

By Rebecca Roats

NOTTINGHAM (1 August)—Orange Bay Kitchen has been serving up an infusion of Jamaican flavours in a laid-back Caribbean atmosphere for six months now. Managed by Keron Deslandes, the 150-seat restaurant is an aromatic jewel amid the bustling shops and eateries in Wester Square. The servers are always happy to help diners select from the variety of delights on the extensive menu, which includes curried goat, oxtail soup, and red snapper. The restaurant is most famous for its jerk chicken. Marinated for 24 hours prior to grilling and served with sides of stewed cabbage and coconut rice, the dish is a good deal at £12.

If you stop in on any Friday night between 7 and 11 P.M., you will enjoy live reggae music.

https://www.dinerreviews.co.uk/orangebaykitchen

Posted on 22 August by Tamika Peterkin, tpeterkin@sunmail.co.uk

Orange Bay Kitchen: 2/5 Stars

After reading a glowing article about Orange Bay Kitchen by Rebecca Roats, I was eager to give this place a try. My husband and I arrived there at 7 P.M. yesterday, keen to enjoy live music with our dinner. Unfortunately, the band's performance that night had been cancelled. Undeterred, we stayed and both ordered the jerk chicken. While the chicken's smoky flavour was outstanding, the stewed cabbage was lacking in flavour. Also, the portion size was smaller than we had anticipated, so we ordered another appetiser to avoid going home hungry. The head chef came out to apologise and was extremely nice, but we will probably not go back anytime soon.

E-Mail Message

To: tpeterkin@sunmail.co.uk

From: vsmith@orangebaykitchen.co.uk

Date: 24 August

Subject: Your review

Attachment: 0258

Dear Ms. Peterkin,

Thank you for visiting Orange Bay Kitchen and leaving a review. Our manager, Keron Deslandes, told me more about your visit and our failure to live up to your expectations that evening. Please accept the attached £20 gift certificate; I do hope that you will give us another try.

During your visit, our band had an equipment malfunction, which is what led to the last-minute cancellation. However, the band will be back performing weekly beginning in September. Also, I want you to know that Head Chef Adio Brown has changed the spices he uses in the stewed cabbage. I am sure you will find them delightful.

Sincerely,

Vea Smith, Owner

Orange Bay Kitchen

questions.explanation:
76. - Dẫn chứng: "I highly recommend you take photos of your roof every year so that you can track its overall condition." (Tôi thực sự khuyên bạn nên chụp ảnh mái nhà hàng năm để có thể theo dõi tình trạng tổng thể của nó).
- Paraphrase: take photos (chụp ảnh) = Taking some photos (Chụp một số bức ảnh).

questions.stem: Who most likely is the speaker?
questions.explanation:
77. - Dẫn chứng: "Thanks again for joining me on today’s tour of the beautiful Wallingford Conservatory." (Cảm ơn một lần nữa vì đã tham gia cùng tôi trong chuyến tham quan Nhà kính Wallingford xinh đẹp ngày hôm nay).
- Paraphrase: joining me on today’s tour (tham gia cùng tôi trong chuyến tham quan hôm nay) = A tour guide (Một hướng dẫn viên du lịch).

questions.stem: What will happen at two o'clock?
questions.explanation:
78. - Dẫn chứng: "...world-renowned botanist Samantha Hughes will be giving a lecture on the care of flowering orchid plants at two o’clock in the community room." (...nhà thực vật học nổi tiếng thế giới Samantha Hughes sẽ có một bài giảng về việc chăm sóc cây hoa lan vào lúc 2 giờ tại phòng cộng đồng).
- Paraphrase: giving a lecture (có một bài giảng) = A lecture will begin (Một bài giảng sẽ bắt đầu).

questions.stem: What is Orchid Caretakers?
questions.explanation:
79. - Dẫn chứng: "Samantha’s work has also been featured in a documentary film called Orchid Caretakers, which you can purchase through the conservatory’s online gift shop." (Công trình của Samantha cũng đã được giới thiệu trong một bộ phim tài liệu có tên Orchid Caretakers, mà bạn có thể mua qua cửa hàng quà tặng trực tuyến của nhà kính).
- Paraphrase: documentary film (phim tài liệu) = A film (Một bộ phim).

questions.stem: What event is taking place?
questions.explanation:
80. - Dẫn chứng: "Before the benefit concert begins, I want to thank all of you for supporting the Hillcaster Community Center." (Trước khi buổi hòa nhạc từ thiện bắt đầu, tôi muốn cảm ơn tất cả các bạn đã ủng hộ Trung tâm Cộng đồng Hillcaster).
- Paraphrase: benefit concert (buổi hòa nhạc từ thiện) = A fund-raising concert (Một buổi hòa nhạc gây quỹ).

questions.stem: What does the organization plan to do?
questions.explanation:
81. - Dẫn chứng: "As you know, our facilities have been in need of some repairs for quite a while... Eighty percent of the proceeds will go to construction at the Hillcaster Community Center." (Như bạn đã biết, cơ sở vật chất của chúng ta đã cần sửa chữa trong một thời gian khá dài... 80% số tiền thu được sẽ dành cho việc xây dựng tại Trung tâm Cộng đồng Hillcaster).
- Paraphrase: facilities... in need of some repairs (cơ sở vật chất... cần sửa chữa) = Repair a building (Sửa chữa một tòa nhà).

questions.stem: What does the speaker encourage the listeners to do?
questions.explanation:
82. - Dẫn chứng: "So during the concert, I want to encourage you to buy food and drinks from the concession stand." (Vì vậy, trong suốt buổi hòa nhạc, tôi muốn khuyến khích các bạn mua đồ ăn và thức uống từ quầy bán đồ ăn nhẹ).
- Paraphrase: buy food and drinks (mua đồ ăn và thức uống) = Purchase refreshments (Mua đồ ăn nhẹ/thức uống giải khát).

questions.stem: What is the topic of the workshop?
questions.explanation:
83. - Dẫn chứng: "we’ll be focusing on using time efficiently as a business owner." (chúng ta sẽ tập trung vào việc sử dụng thời gian hiệu quả với tư cách là chủ doanh nghiệp).
- Paraphrase: using time efficiently (sử dụng thời gian hiệu quả) = Time management (Quản lý thời gian).

questions.stem: What does the speaker imply when he says, “Erina’s at the back of the room”?

options.text: A guest speaker has just arrived.
Attendees should speak clearly and loudly.
An extra chair should be provided.

questions.explanation:
84. - Dẫn chứng: "If you don’t have one yet, Erina’s at the back of the room." (Nếu bạn chưa có [tài liệu], Erina đang ở phía cuối phòng).
- Paraphrase: Erina’s at the back of the room (Erina ở phía cuối phòng) = Assistance is available (Có sự hỗ trợ sẵn sàng [để lấy tài liệu từ Erina]).

questions.stem: What will the listeners do next?

options.text: Sign their names on a list

questions.explanation:
85. - Dẫn chứng: "to start off, we’ll do an exercise to get to know one another better" (để bắt đầu, chúng ta sẽ thực hiện một bài tập để hiểu nhau hơn).
- Paraphrase: exercise to get to know one another (bài tập để làm quen nhau) = Participate in an introductory activity (Tham gia vào một hoạt động giới thiệu/làm quen).

questions.stem: What is a historical site famous for?
questions.explanation:
86. - Dẫn chứng: "At this site, archaeologists have uncovered the remains of a fifth-century marketplace with colorful mosaic tiles on the walls." (Tại địa điểm này, các nhà khảo cổ học đã khai quật được tàn tích của một khu chợ thế kỷ thứ năm với những viên gạch khảm đầy màu sắc trên tường).
- Paraphrase: colorful mosaic tiles (những viên gạch khảm đầy màu sắc) = Some artwork (Một số tác phẩm nghệ thuật).

questions.stem: Why does the speaker apologize?

options.text: An area is closed to the listeners.

questions.explanation:
87. - Dẫn chứng: "And I’m sorry, but taking photos is not allowed, as the flash would damage the tiles." (Và tôi xin lỗi, nhưng việc chụp ảnh không được phép, vì đèn flash sẽ làm hỏng các viên gạch).
- Paraphrase: taking photos is not allowed (việc chụp ảnh không được phép) = The listeners cannot take pictures (Người nghe không thể chụp ảnh).

questions.stem: What does the speaker ask the listeners to do?
questions.explanation:
88. - Dẫn chứng: "As we proceed, please hold on to the handrails on either side." (Khi chúng ta tiến bước, vui lòng bám vào tay vịn ở cả hai bên).
- Paraphrase: hold on to the handrails (bám vào tay vịn) = Use some handrails (Sử dụng tay vịn).

questions.stem: What is the speaker mainly discussing?
questions.explanation:
89. - Dẫn chứng: "As you all know, our agency’s just won an important contract with Parker Auto Parts Company." (Như tất cả các bạn đều biết, đại lý của chúng ta vừa giành được một hợp đồng quan trọng với Công ty Phụ tùng Ô tô Parker).
- Paraphrase: our agency’s just won an important contract (đại lý của chúng ta vừa thắng một hợp đồng quan trọng) = An advertising campaign (Một chiến dịch quảng cáo).

questions.stem: What does the speaker imply when he says, “this is a priority”?

options.text: A supervisor will be observing closely.

questions.explanation:
90. - Dẫn chứng: "I know it’s a tight schedule, but this is a priority." (Tôi biết đây là một lịch trình eo hẹp, nhưng đây là một ưu tiên).
- Paraphrase: tight schedule (lịch trình eo hẹp) = A deadline must be met (Một thời hạn phải được đáp ứng).

questions.stem: What will the listeners do next?
questions.explanation:
91. - Dẫn chứng: "The client has actually started trying to work on this internally, so there’s a rough ad we can start editing. Let’s work on that now." (Khách hàng thực sự đã bắt đầu thử tự thực hiện việc này nội bộ, vì vậy có một bản quảng cáo sơ thảo mà chúng ta có thể bắt đầu chỉnh sửa. Hãy làm việc đó ngay bây giờ).
- Paraphrase: editing (chỉnh sửa) = Revise some work (Sửa lại một số công việc).

questions.stem: Where do the listeners most likely work?
questions.explanation:
92. - Dẫn chứng: "Excuse me, nurses. Your attention please. I’ve been receiving complaints about the free snacks in the hospital break rooms." (Xin lỗi các y tá. Vui lòng chú ý. Tôi đã nhận được những lời phàn nàn về đồ ăn nhẹ miễn phí trong phòng nghỉ của bệnh viện).
- Paraphrase: nurses / hospital break rooms (y tá / phòng nghỉ bệnh viện) = At a hospital (Tại một bệnh viện).

questions.stem: What is the main purpose of the talk?
questions.explanation:
93. - Dẫn chứng: "I’ve been receiving complaints about the free snacks in the hospital break rooms... Some people have mentioned that they don't like the selection of snacks..." (Tôi đã nhận được những lời phàn nàn về đồ ăn nhẹ miễn phí... Một số người đã đề cập rằng họ không thích các loại đồ ăn nhẹ được chọn...).
- Paraphrase: receiving complaints about the free snacks (nhận được phàn nàn về đồ ăn nhẹ) = To address staff complaints (Để giải quyết những phàn nàn của nhân viên).

questions.stem: What does the speaker imply when she says, “That will require management approval”?

options.text: A process has not been followed.
The listeners may be asked to work extra shifts.
The listeners should contact a manager.
A change will not be immediate.

questions.explanation:
94. - Dẫn chứng: "That will require management approval, but I’ll keep you posted." (Điều đó sẽ cần sự chấp thuận của ban quản lý, nhưng tôi sẽ tiếp tục cập nhật cho các bạn).
- Paraphrase: That will require management approval (Điều đó sẽ cần sự chấp thuận của quản lý) = A change will not be immediate (Một sự thay đổi sẽ không diễn ra ngay lập tức).

questions.stem: According to the speaker, what was recently completed?
questions.explanation:
95. - Dẫn chứng: "I’m pleased to welcome you to the celebration for our town’s newly renovated Lakeville Park." (Tôi rất vui mừng chào đón các bạn đến với buổi lễ kỷ niệm công viên Lakeville vừa mới được cải tạo của thị trấn chúng ta).
- Paraphrase: newly renovated Lakeville Park (công viên Lakeville vừa được cải tạo mới) = A park renovation (Một sự cải tạo công viên).

questions.stem: Look at the graphic. Where does the speaker say refreshments will be served?
questions.explanation:
96. - Dẫn chứng: "We’ll end our walk on the hill on the north side of the park. There we’ll be having some free snacks and ice cream." (Chúng ta sẽ kết thúc chuyến đi bộ trên đồi ở phía bắc của công viên. Tại đó, chúng ta sẽ có một ít đồ ăn nhẹ và kem miễn phí).
- Đối chiếu đồ họa: Trên bản đồ công viên, vị trí 1. Hill (Đồi) nằm ở phía Bắc.
- Paraphrase: hill on the north side (ngọn đồi ở phía bắc) = Location 1.

questions.stem: What are the listeners reminded to do?
questions.explanation:
97. - Dẫn chứng: "For those of you taking photos, don’t forget to post them on the city’s Web site." (Đối với những bạn đang chụp ảnh, đừng quên đăng chúng lên trang web của thành phố).
- Paraphrase: post them [photos] on the city’s Web site (đăng chúng [ảnh] lên trang web thành phố) = Post some photographs (Đăng một số bức ảnh).

questions.stem: What is the topic of today’s lecture?
questions.explanation:
98. - Dẫn chứng: "So, we’ve received lots of requests for information on growing a vegetable garden." (Vì vậy, chúng tôi đã nhận được rất nhiều yêu cầu cung cấp thông tin về việc trồng một vườn rau).
- Paraphrase: growing a vegetable garden (trồng một vườn rau) = How to grow vegetables (Cách trồng các loại rau).

questions.stem: Look at the graphic. At what depth should samples be collected this month?
questions.explanation:
99. - Dẫn chứng: "Since this is September, all soil samples in the next six weeks should be taken from the same depth, as seen on this chart." (Vì bây giờ là tháng Chín, tất cả các mẫu đất trong sáu tuần tới nên được lấy ở cùng một độ sâu, như được thấy trên biểu đồ này).
- Đối chiếu đồ họa: Theo bảng "Soil Sampling Timeline", khoảng thời gian September-October (Tháng 9-10) yêu cầu độ sâu là 12 inches.
- Paraphrase: September (Tháng 9) = 12 inches.

questions.stem: What does the speaker encourage the listeners to do?

options.text: Sign up for a mailing list

questions.explanation:
100. - Dẫn chứng: "Oh, and before you leave today, please sign up for our mailing list to stay informed of future lectures." (Ồ, và trước khi các bạn ra về hôm nay, vui lòng đăng ký danh sách gửi thư của chúng tôi để được cập nhật thông tin về các bài giảng trong tương lai).
- Paraphrase: sign up for our mailing list (đăng ký danh sách nhận thư) = Sign up for a mailing list (Đăng ký một danh sách nhận thư).

questions.stem: Former Sendai Company CEO Ken Nakata spoke about ------- career experiences.
questions.explanation: Chỗ trống đứng trước cụm danh từ "career experiences" nên cần một tính từ sở hữu. "His" là tính từ sở hữu phù hợp để thay thế cho "Ken Nakata".

questions.stem: Passengers who will be taking a ------- domestic flight should go to Terminal A.
questions.explanation: Cụm từ "connecting flight" là một danh từ ghép phổ biến trong ngành hàng không, chỉ các "chuyến bay chuyển tiếp" hoặc "chuyến bay nối chuyến".

questions.stem: Fresh and ------- apple-cider donuts are available at Oakcrest Orchard’s retail shop for £6 per dozen.
questions.explanation: Chỗ trống cần một tính từ mang nghĩa tích cực để miêu tả món bánh "apple-cider donuts". "Tasty" (ngon) là lựa chọn hợp lý nhất về nghĩa trong ngữ cảnh ẩm thực.

questions.stem: Zahn Flooring has the widest selection of ------- in the United Kingdom.
questions.explanation: Dựa vào tên công ty "Zahn Flooring" (Flooring liên quan đến sàn nhà), danh từ "tiles" (gạch lát) là sản phẩm phù hợp nhất để công ty này kinh doanh.

questions.stem: One responsibility of the IT department is to ensure that the company is using ------- software.
questions.explanation: Chỗ trống đứng trước danh từ "software" nên cần một tính từ. "Updated" (được cập nhật) là tính từ hoàn chỉnh nhất để mô tả trạng thái của phần mềm.

questions.stem: It is wise to check a company’s dress code ------- visiting its head office.
questions.explanation: Dựa vào ngữ nghĩa, việc kiểm tra quy định về trang phục (dress code) nên được thực hiện "before" (trước khi) đến thăm văn phòng trụ sở để đảm bảo sự chuyên nghiệp.

questions.stem: Wexler Store’s management team expects that employees will ------- support any new hires.
questions.explanation: Trạng từ "enthusiastically" bổ nghĩa cho động từ "support", diễn tả thái độ làm việc tích cực, nhiệt tình giúp đỡ nhân viên mới của đội ngũ quản lý.

questions.stem: Wheel alignments and brake system ------- are part of our vehicle service plan.
questions.explanation: Chỗ trống đứng sau cụm "brake system" (hệ thống phanh) và song song với "Wheel alignments", nên cần một danh từ số nhiều. "Inspections" (việc kiểm tra) tạo thành cụm từ kỹ thuật phù hợp.

questions.stem: Registration for the Marketing Coalition Conference is now open ------- September 30.
questions.explanation: Giới từ "until" (cho đến khi) được dùng để chỉ mốc thời gian kết thúc của một hành động kéo dài (việc đăng ký).

questions.stem: Growth in the home entertainment industry has been ------- this quarter.
questions.explanation: Dựa vào ngữ nghĩa, "limited" (hạn chế) là tính từ phù hợp nhất để mô tả tình trạng tăng trưởng của ngành công nghiệp giải trí tại nhà trong quý này.

questions.stem: Hawson Furniture will be making ------- on the east side of town on Thursday.
questions.explanation: Sau động từ "make" thường là một danh từ để tạo thành cụm danh từ. "Make deliveries" (thực hiện việc giao hàng) là một cụm từ cố định phổ biến.

questions.stem: The Marlton City Council does not have the authority to ------- parking on city streets.
questions.explanation: Hội đồng thành phố có thẩm quyền liên quan đến luật lệ, vì vậy động từ "prohibit" (nghiêm cấm) đỗ xe là phù hợp nhất về ngữ cảnh pháp lý.

questions.stem: Project Earth Group is ------- for ways to reduce transport-related greenhouse gas emissions.
questions.explanation: Cụm động từ "looking for" có nghĩa là tìm kiếm. Trong ngữ cảnh này, tập đoàn đang tìm kiếm các phương pháp để cắt giảm khí thải.

questions.stem: Our skilled tailors are happy to design a custom-made suit that fits your style and budget -------.
questions.explanation: Trạng từ "perfectly" (một cách hoàn hảo) đứng cuối câu để bổ nghĩa cho động từ "fits" (vừa vặn).

questions.stem: Project manager Hannah Chung has proved to be very ------- with completing company projects.
questions.explanation: Sau cấu trúc "to be + very" cần một tính từ để miêu tả tính chất của chủ ngữ. "Helpful" (có ích/giúp ích) là tính từ phù hợp.

questions.stem: Lehua Vacation Club members will receive double points ------- the month of August at participating hotels.
questions.explanation: Giới từ "during" (trong suốt) được dùng để chỉ một hành động diễn ra trong một khoảng thời gian xác định (tháng Tám).

questions.stem: The costumes were not received ------- enough to be used in the first dress rehearsal.
questions.explanation: Trạng từ "soon" (sớm) thường đi với "enough" để tạo thành cụm "soon enough" (đủ sớm), phù hợp để nói về việc nhận trang phục kịp buổi diễn.

questions.stem: As a former publicist for several renowned orchestras, Mr. Wu would excel in the role of event -------.
questions.explanation: Chỗ trống đứng sau danh từ "event" nên cần một danh từ khác để tạo thành danh từ ghép chỉ người. "Event organizer" (người tổ chức sự kiện) là cụm từ chính xác.

questions.stem: The northbound lane on Davis Street will be ------- closed because of the city’s bridge reinforcement project.
questions.explanation: Trạng từ "temporarily" (tạm thời) là lựa chọn hợp lý nhất để mô tả việc đóng cửa làn đường phục vụ cho một dự án thi công cầu đường.

questions.stem: Airline representatives must handle a wide range of passenger issues, ------- missed connections to lost luggage.
questions.explanation: Cấu trúc "from A to B" được dùng để liệt kê một phạm vi các vấn đề, từ việc lỡ chuyến bay nối chuyến cho đến thất lạc hành lý.

questions.stem: The meeting notes were ------- deleted, but Mr. Hahm was able to recreate them from memory.
questions.explanation: Trạng từ "accidentally" (vô tình/ngẫu nhiên) bổ nghĩa cho động từ "deleted" để diễn tả một hành động không mong muốn.

questions.stem: The current issue of Farming Scene magazine predicts that the price of corn will rise 5 percent over the ------- year.
questions.explanation: Cụm từ "the next year" (năm tới) thường được dùng trong các dự báo kinh tế để chỉ khoảng thời gian sắp tới.

questions.stem: Anyone who still ------- to take the fire safety training should do so before the end of the month.
questions.explanation: Chủ ngữ "Anyone" là đại từ bất định số ít, vì vậy động từ chính phải chia số ít ở thì hiện tại đơn. "Needs" là đáp án đúng ngữ pháp.

questions.stem: Emerging technologies have ------- begun to transform the shipping industry in ways that were once unimaginable.
questions.explanation: Trạng từ "already" (đã/rồi) dùng để nhấn mạnh một hành động đã bắt đầu diễn ra và đang có tác động ở hiện tại.

questions.stem: The company handbook outlines the high ------- that employees are expected to meet every day.
questions.explanation: Danh từ "standards" (tiêu chuẩn) đi với động từ "meet" tạo thành cụm "meet standards" (đáp ứng các tiêu chuẩn), phù hợp với ngữ cảnh sổ tay nhân viên.

questions.stem: Because ------- of the board members have scheduling conflicts, the board meeting will be moved to a date when all can attend.
questions.explanation: "Some" là đại từ duy nhất phù hợp để chỉ một phần trong nhóm (một vài thành viên), dẫn đến việc phải dời lịch họp vì tất cả không thể tham gia.

questions.stem: The project ------- the collaboration of several teams across the company.
questions.explanation: Động từ "required" (yêu cầu/đòi hỏi) phù hợp để diễn tả việc dự án cần sự phối hợp giữa nhiều nhóm khác nhau.

questions.stem: What does the invoice suggest about Green Canyon?

questions.stem: Why most likely did Green Canyon receive a discount on its order dated June 10 ?

options.text: It belongs to the Frequent Buyer Club.
It spent more than $4,000 on merchandise
It is located near an Orbys Distributors supply center.

questions.explanation:
Dẫn chứng 1: Hóa đơn ngày 10/6 có Subtotal là $4,650.00 và dòng Discount (10%) là $465.00.
Dẫn chứng 2: Thông báo ghi "A 10% discount for orders of more than $4,000".
Paraphrase: Subtotal $4,650 > $4,000 ≈ spent more than $4,000 on merchandise (chi hơn $4.000 cho hàng hóa).

questions.stem: According to the notice, what is changing at Orbys Distributors?
questions.explanation: Paraphrase: switching to electronic invoicing (chuyển sang hóa đơn điện tử) ≈ Its invoicing system (hệ thống lập hóa đơn của nó).

questions.stem: What is suggested about Mr. Tesoriero?

options.text: He asked to meet with Mr. Singh.
He is interested in employment at Orbys Distributors.
He recently placed an order for some construction machinery.
He has been a customer of Orbys Distributors for about twenty years.

questions.explanation:
Dẫn chứng 1: Thông báo ghi: "system has been in use since Orbys Distributors was founded over twenty years ago." (hệ thống đã được dùng từ khi Orbys thành lập hơn 20 năm trước).
Dẫn chứng 2: Email ghi: "Mr. Tesoriero was one of our very first customers. Since we first opened for business..." (Ông Tesoriero là một trong những khách hàng đầu tiên. Kể từ khi chúng ta bắt đầu kinh doanh...).
Paraphrase: first customer / opened 20 years ago (Khách hàng đầu tiên / Khai trương cách đây 20 năm) ≈ customer... for about twenty years (khách hàng trong khoảng 20 năm).
